name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
summary: Hornizz Brimbuzzle thinks there is money in the ghosts of the Valley of Bones. He figures the Magram centaurs would pay plenty for ghost energy, and he gives you a crate of ghost magnets to draw the spirits out.

sections.title: A Haunted Valley
sections.body: Hornizz points you southeast, to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. It sounds frightening, he admits, but surely it is scarier still for the Magram. He is sure that ghost energy captured there would be worth plenty to those centaurs.

sections.title: Between the Dead Goliaths
sections.body: He hands you a crate of ghost magnets. Set down between the two huge skeletons in the valley, known as the Dead Goliaths, a magnet lures the ghosts toward it. From them you take ghost-o-plasm, which is what Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He wants eight ghost-o-plasms brought back to him, along with the crate.

sections.title: Back with the Haul
sections.body: When you return, Hornizz notices that some of the ghost-o-plasm has rubbed off on you, and he calls it slimy. He reckons it a fortune in the making, provided the centaurs can be persuaded of what it is.

faq.answer: Hornizz Brimbuzzle keeps a camp just southwest of the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace. He wants to sell ghost energy to the Magram centaurs.

faq.q: Where is the Valley of Bones?
aliases: where do i find the ghosts
faq.answer: Hornizz places the Valley of Bones to the southeast. The two Dead Goliaths, the big skeletons where the magnet is set, stand at its southern end.
He is sure the Magram centaurs would pay plenty for ghost energy captured in the haunted Valley of Bones, and ghost-o-plasm is what he means to sell them.

faq.q: How does the ghost magnet work?
faq.answer: A magnet placed between the two Dead Goliaths draws the valley's ghosts toward it, and the ghosts yield ghost-o-plasm.
